name: Aldric's Workshop
player_description: The largest workshop on the row, closest to the east gate. Leatherwork and metal repairs. The smell of tanned hide and hot metal. Tools arranged with the same precision as Rufus's shop but with a different aesthetic — some of the tools are not Roman pattern. Aldric works with his back to the door and does not look up when people enter.
gm_notes: DC 12 Persuasion or Athletics (helping physically): Aldric will repair non-military personal equipment the fort fabrica refuses. Prices fair, timeline accurate. DC 12 History (examining his work): techniques match Germanic craft patterns, not Roman guild training. DC 14 History: specifically Suebian, not Marcomanni. DC 15 Persuasion (Acquaintance+): Aldric repaired a belt fitting last week with a concealed message cylinder slot. He describes it as a craftsman — material, tolerances, unusual design of the concealment slot — and waits. He does not know what it means. He knows the fitting was unusual and the man paid extra for silence. He mentions it because the party asked. Do NOT add suspicion to his description. He is precise. His receipts box (in the back): contains collateral documentation on three officers' unpaid debts. He has never used it. DC 16 Investigation to locate it; DC 14 Persuasion to get him to show a specific receipt.
